summary: I restored the marshmallow 3.21.3 core under src/marshmallow: the missing utils helpers (timestamps, ISO parsing, get/set_value, get_func_args, is_aware and others), ErrorStore and merge_errors, the class registry, decorator hook registration, and validator error formatting with the URL regex. I also rebuilt the Schema load/dump/validate pipeline with processor and validator hooks, the full Field set including the deprecated default/missing accessors, and OrderedSet add/discard; the last full-suite run showed 1228 passed and 1 failed, the failure being test_version_attributes_deprecated, which cannot pass because the .venv has no installed marshmallow distribution metadata.
